8.note: all 9 areas; dash and jobs dry; Website-freeze lead: no cause found

9.note: dash, pdf, boards, sync, editor, jobs; import/export/tools running

seen: A PDF/Word/Markdown import that finishes after you open another résumé takes over that editor, and your typing goes into the imported résumé
1-Page Fit replaces spacing that is already tighter than its ladder, then shrinks the text of a résumé that already fit on one page
Word export: nested numbered lists and paragraphs inside a bullet are not indented under the bullet's text
JSON Resume import drops the company, website, GPA and username-only profiles from pre-1.0 JSON Resume files
Text/PDF/Word import: 'Degree Subject, School' puts the school in Field of Study and leaves Institution empty
Text import: 'Company — City, ST' over the role line makes the city the job title and moves the real title into the description
Double-clicking a card's Copy or New Cover on the Dashboard creates two records
Signing out in one tab can make a second tab delete every résumé from the account's cloud
A restored job-form draft writes back stale values for fields the user never touched, including status
Summary 'Follow-ups due' shows an arbitrary 6 in board order, unsorted, and silently hides the rest
Board/Backlog/List/Calendar filters (and group-by, folded lanes) carry over when switching to another project (refuted: intended)
Job scanner finds multi-word tech phrases inside other words, in both the posting and the résumé
'.NET' in a job posting becomes the keyword 'NET', which matches 'net revenue' and is written into Skills as 'NET'
Job match counts the heading of a section that prints nothing (all entries hidden or none)
The 'read best-effort, check every section' import notice disappears when you switch editor tabs
A photo or contact-icon upload that finishes after you open another résumé is written into that résumé (icons: it overwrites that résumé's whole icon set)
1-Page Fit that cannot reach one page still leaves the text at 9 pt, and its notice only mentions spacing
Markdown export drops bold, italic, underline and strike-through from the summary, descriptions and the cover-letter body
ATS text prints a list item's second paragraph at column 0, detached from its bullet
Text/PDF import: an employer or school name typed in capitals on its own line becomes a custom section, and the real Experience/Education section disappears
Text/PDF import: 'Role' over 'Company ⇥ Date' is read as a grouped employer, so role and company swap and the next job gets the wrong company
Text/PDF import: a degree line above 'School ⇥ Date' is left out of the entry's header and lands in its description, so Degree is empty
Undo on 'Generated letter applied' writes the old letter into a different résumé opened meanwhile
Cover letter generator quotes a job title, company or skills the user hid with the eye
A job or project brought back with Undo after its deletion synced is deleted for good if that restore never reaches the cloud
Job/board flush replaces an edit typed while it read the cloud with another device's older copy
Restoring a job backup in a fresh browser silently drops the user's edited demo job (demo_1) in favour of the untouched demo
List view Salary sort misreads European amounts: '€60.000' sorts as 60 and '2,5 LPA' as 25 LPA
A monthly repeating issue due on the 29th, 30th or 31st moves to an earlier day for good after one short month
Deleting or retyping the epic the view is filtered by leaves a filter that hides every issue and cannot be unticked
On a Kanban board, a card's 'Move to' can put it in the middle of the column when the project has used sprints
Job scanner lists a tech phrase and each of its words as separate keywords, e.g. 'CI/CD', 'CI' and 'CD'
Salary figures like '$150K–$180K' become missing keywords, and '+' writes '150K' into Skills
A summary, description or cover-letter body changed from outside while its box has the caret keeps showing the old text, and the next keystroke writes the old text back
Awards section title is left alone at the foot of a page when the first award's title or issuer wraps
Certifications section title passes no presence, so a wrapping first certificate leaves the heading orphaned
Cover Letter Text export prints a list item's second paragraph as a separate paragraph, cut off from its bullet and splitting the list
Text/PDF/Word import: an 'Expected May 2025' graduation date is not read as a date, and it ends up as the Degree
Text/PDF/Word import: 'Since 2019' loses its 'ongoing' meaning, so the job prints as a single year
JSON Resume import silently drops every profile that is not LinkedIn or GitHub (X/Twitter, GitLab, Stack Overflow, portfolio…)
Cover letter generator writes 'as a HR Manager' / 'as a SRE': acronym titles starting with a consonant letter get 'a' although they are read with a vowel sound
Signing out in one tab leaves a second tab's unsaved résumés in the browser with no owner, and the next account to sign in uploads them to its own cloud
Undo from a job toast, or a job form reopened after leaving the job pages, writes this tab's old job list over another tab's newer one
On a project page, the 'c' key and the top bar's Create put the new issue in the first project in the list, not the project you are viewing
List view and Backlog: an issue created while filters are set can vanish with no word (R4-DUX-08 was fixed on the Board only)
Undo on 'Checklist item deleted' writes back a stale checklist once the checklist has remounted, losing items added or ticked since
Undo on an ATS Check fix (Standardize Headings, Put Job Title First, Grids 1) changes a different résumé opened in the meantime
Undo on 'Template: …' or 'Spacing: …' deletes contact icons uploaded (and the page size set) while the notice was up
PDF prints a bare '•' (or an empty row) for a skill group with no category and no skills; Word, Markdown and ATS text leave it out
References title is left alone at the foot of a page when the first reference card's fields wrap
Skills title (Inline/Bullet, one column) is orphaned when the first group wraps to 4+ lines
Text/PDF/Word import: when each job prints 'Company' over 'Role ⇥ Date' with no blank line between jobs, every later job gets the first job's company
Text/PDF/Word import: consecutive 'School' over 'Degree ⇥ Dates' entries with no blank line give the first entry the next school and leave the second with no institution
JSON Resume export then import of a résumé on Date format 'As entered' (the default) prints every date as '2020-01' instead of 'Jan 2020'
Text/PDF/Word import: 'Role, Company — City, ST' (or 'Role, Company ⇥ City, ST ⇥ Dates') makes the city the company and leaves the company inside the job title
Text/PDF/Word/Markdown import: a contact line separated by ' — ', ' / ' or ', ' yields no email, phone or location; it is printed as an 'Additional Information' section instead
Text/PDF/Word import: skills separated by ' • ', ' · ' or ' | ' are stored as one skill, so Tags, Bars and the Sidebar's Stacked style show one long chip
Share panel shows a Publish result for the résumé it started on after another résumé opens, so Update or Unpublish then overwrites or deletes the first résumé's public link
After sign-out, the recovery notice and its raw backups stay in the browser, so the next person can download the previous account's whole résumé or job list
Signing in on a new browser adds the demo 'Google' job to the account, and every device gets it back, even after the user deleted it
Quick search: typing an exact issue key like 'LIFE-1' and pressing Enter opens LIFE-10 (or another LIFE-1x), and the exact issue can drop out of the list
Changing an epic's Issue type to Task/Story/Bug silently and permanently unlinks all its child issues, with no warning or Undo
Quick search can't find an issue by its exact key when 8 or more longer keys start with it (LIFE-1 hidden by LIFE-10…LIFE-17)
ATS plain text (Export → ATS text, ATS tab Copy/Download) prints a website/LinkedIn/GitHub's typed value instead of its Link URL, so the profile address is lost
ATS Check calls a phone field with more than 15 digits 'Short phone number format' and asks for an area/country code
Bullets pasted from Microsoft Word become plain paragraphs that start with '·' and a run of spaces, not a list
Design → Typography shows no font selected when the résumé's custom Google font is not in this browser's saved list, so the font it prints in cannot be seen or picked again
JSON Resume export then import moves a description's paragraphs above its bullets and drops bold, links, numbering and nesting (jobs, education, projects, volunteering, custom sections)
A section whose title the user cleared prints its internal type id ('## custom', '## experience', 'CUSTOM') in Markdown and ATS text
Text/PDF/Word/Markdown import: a job title with a comma ('Software Engineer, Backend') becomes the location, and the real location goes to 'Additional Information'
Text/PDF/Word import: a date range followed by its length, e.g. 'January 2020 - Present (4 years 9 months)' as in LinkedIn's PDF, is not read as a date, so each job loses its role and dates
Text/PDF/Word import: a range with a two-digit end year ('2011-12', '2019-21', '2019–21') becomes a month ('Dec 2011'), or is not a date at all and ends up as the Degree
Word import drops non-breaking hyphens, so '2019‑2021' becomes '20192021' (no dates, read as the job title) and '555‑0100' becomes '5550100'
Imported job dates written any other way than YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. a timestamp) are kept but vanish from the card, the job page and the Summary
An imported job's `position` / `appliedAt` appear in the CSV export but nowhere in the tracker
Scrum backlog: a row dropped at the foot of the Backlog lands above reopened issues from a completed sprint, or doesn't move at all
Board grouped by Epic/Priority/Type with no issues says 'No issues match these filters.' when no filter is set, and shows no columns to create in
Undo of an issue deleted before its epic was deleted brings it back linked to the gone epic: 'Issues without an epic' hides it and the Parent epic picker can't clear it
List view: sorting by Summary uses raw code-point order, so accented titles sort after 'z' and 'Item 10' before 'Item 2'
Clicking into an issue title, sprint name or project name and clicking away without typing puts back the old text over another tab's newer edit
ATS Check says 'Missing or invalid candidate name' (critical, 0 pts) for a full name that includes pronouns or a nickname in parentheses
Changing a Done column's category, even by mistake and then back, reopens every done issue and wipes its resolved date, with no warning and no Undo; long-done issues then flood back onto the board
A comment typed in the issue view disappears without a word when the view is closed or another issue (epic, child, copy) is opened
With 'Group by' set, dropping a card into another swimlane's cell is accepted, but the card lands back in its own lane: its epic, priority or type never changes (refuted)
On the List and Calendar, which show epics, the Type filter has no 'Epic' option: there is no way to list only epics, and ticking any type hides every epic

If you sign out with a job's Edit form open, the form says the job was 'deleted in another tab' and offers 'Save as a new job'. That button copies the previous account's job into the signed-out browser, and the next account to sign in uploads it.
Re-importing a jobs JSON file whose entries have no id (or a numeric id), such as an export from another tool, adds every job again each time and reports them as new imports (refuted)
A job's interview stage cannot be cleared on the job form when that stage is not in this browser's stage lists (imported, synced from another device, or a custom stage removed since)
List view Salary sort treats a range written with the thousands only on the second number ('$40-50,000', '€40-50.000') as 40, so it sorts below every real salary
The Summary's 'Upcoming deadlines' card shows only the first six deadlines and hides the rest with no count, unlike the fixed 'Follow-ups due' card beside it (refuted)
Deleting a résumé from the Dashboard silently removes every saved design that only that résumé held, so it is gone from Design → Template → Your designs on all other résumés and from the /new page
Browser Back from the editor (or from Job Tracker/Projects) returns to the Dashboard at the top, not where the user had scrolled
A PDF/Word import started on the Dashboard that finishes after the user signs out adds that person's résumé to the signed-out browser's list (and to the next account that signs in)
After a cover letter is opened, the Dashboard's Career History switches to the oldest résumé instead of the one the user was working on
When a second tab of the app is open, one conflict between devices produces two identical "(conflict copy)" résumés, and they show up on every device

Undo on a deleted job, cleared job list or deleted project after signing out puts the previous account's data back in the browser with no owner, and the next account to sign in uploads it to its own cloud
An old sign-in error bubble reappears under 'Sign in with Google' after signing out, although a later sign-in worked
Design → Line Height saves values like 1.4000000000000001, and clicking into the box shows that long number instead of 1.4

A dashboard résumé card keeps showing a wrong picture of page 1 (in Noto Sans instead of the résumé's font, or with no photo) after one visit where the font or photo could not be downloaded. It stays wrong on later visits until the résumé is edited.

1-Page Fit has no Undo. It replaces all five spacing numbers and can shrink the text to 9 pt, and the résumé's previous margins, gaps, line height and text sizes cannot be brought back. Balanced and Spacious both offer Undo.

A section whose entries are all blank (for example a Skills section just added, or one whose groups have Category and Skills hidden with their eyes) prints its heading alone in the PDF and in Word. Markdown, ATS text and the ATS checker all treat it as not printed.

Text/PDF/Word import: a same-year range such as 'Jun – Aug 2021' or 'May – August 2020' is not read as a date, so the job's role becomes 'Jun', its start date becomes the end month, and the real job title goes into the description

Markdown, ATS-text or PDF round trip of a Sidebar, Executive, Timeline (or any role-first) résumé swaps role and company for every job whose title has no word from the importer's role list, e.g. 'Sous Chef', 'Barista', 'Cashier', 'Pharmacist'

Text/PDF/Word import of a two-column profile such as LinkedIn's 'Save to PDF' gives the résumé the name 'Contact', files the real name, headline and location as Certifications, and puts the LinkedIn URL and 'Top Skills' into 'Additional Information' (refuted)
Text/PDF/Word import: an education dated 'Graduated May 2021' or 'Class of 2020' becomes the Degree, and the real degree lands in the description
Text/PDF/Word import: a company line written 'Company, City, ST' (e.g. 'Google, Mountain View, CA') keeps the city in the company name and leaves Location empty
Text/PDF/Word/Markdown import: a header location with a ZIP code ('Chicago, IL 60601') or a street address is not read as the location and is printed as an 'Additional Information' section
Cover Letter Text (.txt) prints the typed website/LinkedIn/GitHub value instead of its Link URL when the field has no Display label, so the address is lost
JSON Resume export writes the typed LinkedIn/GitHub/website value, not its Link URL, into the schema's profile url and basics.url, so other JSON Resume tools get a broken link
Share panel's 'What is public' list names a section whose title was cleared by its internal type id, e.g. 'custom: 2 entries' or 'experience: 3 entries'

Job Tracker's Career History shows the cover letter you last opened, not your résumé: a blank letter shows 'Your Name' and one empty job, and a letter made from a résumé shows an old copy of its jobs (refuted)
STAR Optimizer opened on a selection that spans two bullets (or two paragraphs) joins them with no space ('Led migrationCut costs by 30%'), and Apply saves that joined text as one bullet (refuted)
STAR Optimizer on a word selected with its trailing space (a Windows double-click) glues the rewritten word to the next word on Apply, e.g. 'handled QA' becomes 'ManagedQA' (refuted)
Cover letter generator cuts a skill list in the middle of a parenthesis, writing '…utilizing Java, Python, Go, AWS (EC2.' into the letter (refuted)
A double-click on Create project, or pressing Enter twice in its Name field, makes two identical projects, the second keyed HR2
Closing an issue with its Description editor open, even with nothing typed, writes the old text over a newer description saved meanwhile in another tab or pulled from the cloud
The own-details role starter on /new drops the user's US Letter paper size and uploaded contact icons, so the new résumé prints on A4 with stock icons
A lettered or Roman-numbered list (a., i., A., I.) turned into 1., 2. when pasted or when an imported description was edited, and two numbered lists side by side merged into one count
Design > Spacing > Line Height typed with a decimal comma (1,6) was stored as 1, so the whole resume was squeezed with no message
The Job Tracker list's Résumé column showed '—' for a job linked to a résumé that was since deleted, as if it had never been linked, while the job page says 'Résumé deleted'

Importing a file whose entries named neither a company nor a role (another tracker's 'companyName'/'jobTitle' export, or a list of empty objects) added one blank 'Untitled Company' card per entry and reported them as imported

A job moved to the wrong status by mistake (a card dropped on the wrong board column, 'Move to', a click on the job page's stepper or status menu) had no Undo, and moving it back by hand left a false history entry and an applied date, so the Summary kept counting it at that step
A blank or eyes-off entry still prints in the PDF and preview: a gap, an empty grid cell, a bare Timeline dot, and a split 'Group roles by company' group
If storage is too full to set aside a job or project list's unsent changes at sign-out, those changes are lost, and the next sign-in deletes that account's whole list from the cloud
One job the cloud refuses (an imported id with '/', or a nested array) stops the job sync, and every other job in that batch is held back and called 'too large'
Word import: an entry header laid out as a table row is split into one line per cell, so fields land in the wrong place
Text/Word/Markdown import: contacts written as a bulleted list are not read (email becomes the job title, the rest goes to Additional Information, a link label starts with a bullet)
Import: a job header 'Role at Company' / 'Role @ Company' is not split, so Company is empty
Word import: an alignment tab (<w:ptab/>) between a title and its date is dropped, gluing the text and losing the date
Word export writes a file Word cannot open when any printed text contains a C0 control character
The .docx résumé and cover letter carry Author 'Un-named' and no title in their document properties
Markdown export splits a 'Group roles by company' group at a blank or all-eyes-off entry
If the description changes in another tab or device while the STAR Optimizer is open, Apply puts the rewrite as loose text at the top of the description and leaves the original bullet in place
Job scanner reads figures with a unit other than K/M/B ('3x', '10x', '200ms', '#1', '1st') as missing keywords, and '+' writes them into Skills
Public résumé page keeps showing, and downloading, the previous résumé after the tab moves to another share link

PDF: with the Skills style set to Stacked or Tags, a skill group's category heading (and Stacked's thin rule under it) can be left alone at the bottom of a page while that group's skills move to the next page
Story points: typing an unreadable number such as '2,5' (a decimal comma) erases the issue's points instead of keeping them
Project settings: a fractional WIP limit ('2.5') silently removes the column's limit, while the board's own limit dialog saves it as 2
Deleting a job the cloud refused (an imported id with '/'), or clearing all jobs while one is in the list, stops the job sync
A website, LinkedIn or GitHub typed as just 'https://', 'http://' or 'www.' prints as a blank contact in the PDF, Word, Markdown and the cover letter
Text/PDF/Word import: an undated entry in a dated section is swallowed by its neighbour, even after a blank line; the ATS-text export does not round-trip
Text/PDF/Word import: 'B.S. Computer Science, GPA 3.8' puts 'GPA 3.8' in Field of Study and leaves GPA empty
Markdown import: reference-style links are not read; contacts lose addresses and definition lines land in the last entry
Text/PDF/Word import: 'Dean’s List (2018, 2019)' gets the title 'Dean’s List (2018' and only the last year as its date
Word export joins the two words around a line-tab (U+000B) or form feed (U+000C) into one word, where Markdown and ATS text keep them apart
Job scanner reads a posting's web addresses, e-mail domains and hashtags as missing keywords, and '+' writes them into Skills
STAR Optimizer opened from an empty bullet (or empty line) puts its result at the end of the description and leaves the empty bullet printing a bare bullet
ATS Check's fix notices name a section whose title was cleared by its internal type id, and the headings warning lists it as an empty quote
If a native .json résumé's own "name" is not a string, the editor and Dashboard crash on every visit and every synced device, or Rename stops working
A contact icon picked from the header icon picker ('icon:<id>' / 'pack:<id>') was fetched as an image URL on every PDF build, leaving a retry pending so the dashboard card picture was never kept
Backlog point bubbles and the Epic panel show point totals with floating-point noise ('0.30000000000000004')

If storage is too full for a job or project list's first sync record, the list quietly stops syncing while the icon says 'synced'. Deleted jobs come back, and at sign-out the account's list stays in the browser, where the next account to sign in uploads it
Design → Spacing → Line Height: − / + from a two-decimal value (Spacious 1.65, 1-Page Fit 1.35 / 1.25) jumped 0.15 and skipped a step, and a typed 1.35 / 1.65 was stored as 1.4 / 1.6
Job match and the ATS keyword check counted a certificate's Link label after its Link URL was cleared, although nothing prints it and the editor hides its box
If a task is renamed in another tab or on another device while its text box is open, clicking away without typing puts the old text back over the newer one
An imported job's day written month-first ('Oct 15, 2026') or as 'YYYY/MM/DD' / '2026-1-5' is left as text, and the Summary lists even a passed one under 'Upcoming deadlines'
